headline: UK House Prices See Largest Drop in Three Years, According to Lloyds
summary: The average UK house price fell 1.2% to £296,285, marking the largest drop in three years.
why: Housing market data serves as a key consumer wealth indicator and reflects the transmission of elevated mortgage rates to real estate values.

impacts.name: UK Housing
impacts.why: Falling property valuations indicate slowing real estate market activity under higher borrowing costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
